questions.q: For a healthy adult, the Acceptable Macronutrient Distribution Range (AMDR) for fat is:
questions.explain: The AMDR for fat for adults is 20-35% of total daily caloric intake.

questions.q: Metabolic rate typically begins to decline in adulthood (roughly 2% per decade after age 30). What is the primary physiological reason for this decline?
options: Decreased efficiency of the thyroid gland
Reduced absorptive capacity of the small intestine
questions.explain: Lean body mass (muscle) is the most metabolically active tissue. The gradual loss of muscle mass (sarcopenia) leads to a reduction in Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR).

questions.q: Which dietary pattern is most strongly supported by evidence for preventing cardiovascular disease and managing hypertension in adults?
options: DASH (Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension) Diet
questions.explain: The DASH diet (rich in fruits, vegetables, whole grains, low-fat dairy; low in sodium/saturated fat) is clinically proven to lower blood pressure.
